portal_hypertension.title: Urostomy-associated stomal variceal hemorrhage secondary to portal hypertension: A case report and interventional radiology-guided management.
portal_hypertension.authors: Sun C, Mangio H, Bryan H 3rd
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：造口静脉曲张出血与显着的发病率、高再出血率和每次出血约3%-4%的死亡率相关。 临床提示：迄今为止，关于尿路造口相关造口静脉曲张的治疗策略的讨论有限。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Stomal varices are a rare manifestation of ectopic portosystemic collateralization in patients with portal hypertension and are most commonly reported in association with ileostomies and colostomies. Stomal variceal hemorrhages are associated with significant morbidity, high rebleeding rates, and mortality of approximately 3%-4% per bleeding episode. To date, there has been limited discussion on treatment strategies for urostomy-associated stomal varices. We report a case of recurrent, transfusion-dependent bleeding from an ileal conduit urostomy in a 58-year-old man with portal hypertension secondary to metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) and alcohol-related cirrhosis. portal_hypertension.title: Combined Access Strategies for Portal Vein Recanalization with TIPS in Pediatric Chronic Portal Vein Thrombosis: A Series of Three Cases.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of vascular and interventional radiology : JVIR
portal_hypertension.authors: Al Akoum M, Tarhini H, Noun P
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：经颈静脉肝内门体分流术（PVR-TIPS）的门静脉再通是一种新兴的血管内选择，用于治疗伴有海绵样变的儿童慢性门静脉血栓形成。 临床提示：我们描述了三名儿科患者（11 个月至 11 岁），他们使用个性化的经脾、经肝和经颈静脉通路策略成功接受了 PVR-TIPS。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal vein recanalization with transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (PVR-TIPS) is an emerging endovascular option for pediatric chronic portal vein thrombosis with cavernous transformation. We describe three pediatric patients (11 months-11 years) who underwent successful PVR-TIPS using individualized transsplenic, transhepatic, and transjugular access strategies. Technical success was achieved in all cases, with restoration of portal venous flow, decompression of portal venous collaterals, and TIPS creation to maintain portal vein patency after recanalization.
